## What is this feature for?

Permissions support collaboration on private maps without granting more access than required.

## Before you start

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Access** | User, Map owner, Editor, Viewer, Administrator |

## Illustration


![Understand sharing and permissions — desktop screen](/docs/screenshots/map-members-en-light.png)

![Understand sharing and permissions — mobile screen](/docs/screenshots/map-members-en-mobile.png)

## How do I use it?

1. The owner invites an email address.
2. They choose viewer or editor access.
3. The recipient accepts; the owner can later change or revoke access.

### Expected result

The owner controls members and ownership transfer.

## How does it work?

- The owner controls members and ownership transfer.
- Editors change permitted content; viewers have read-only access.
- Instance administrator status does not implicitly expose private maps.

## Good to know

:::note
- Ownership transfer is sensitive and requires explicit confirmation.
:::
